name: decompose
description: Split a complex business question into smaller sub-questions, dispatch each to a local LLM (e.g. gemma4 via Ollama), and aggregate the results into a single answer. Returns immediately with an operation ID; the aggregated answer is pushed as a progress notification. Use `await` with the operation ID to retrieve the full result.

custom.usage: Call with a complex question as the input. The tool will decompose it into sub-questions, run each against the local LLM, and return a summarized answer.
custom.local_llm: Requires Ollama running on port 11434 with gemma4 pulled. Run: ollama pull gemma4
custom.models: Change llm_provider.model in .ahma/decompose.json to use a different local model.
custom.privacy: All LLM calls stay on your machine — no data is sent to cloud providers.
